scope: Native companion preparation and owner lifetime
change: The companion accepts successive stdin triples in one native owner. Exact guidance and retrieved-context checkpoints reuse preparation; each turn supplies its complete current packet and explicit history. A changed retrieval restores guidance, and changed model/language/covenant reopens. EOF frees both checkpoints and the model.
boundaries: Complete covenant and packet text preserved
Actual token IDs decide reuse; a nonempty suffix replaces the uncommitted boundary prediction
Old context checkpoint invalidates before shared KV is overwritten
Second recurrent spare is charged with exact geometry through the existing memory lease
Follow-up prefill uses admitted scratch width instead of the old 64-position floor
Recurrent copying requires both native enqueues to return1; refusal0 is observed
Retained per-turn ownership and final release have distinct receipts

validation.independent_source_review: No remaining token-order, shared-KV or partial-token blocker; reported metadata issues repaired

measurement_scope: Small samples with one scheduled background GPU worker still active. Another owner released its model at a verified checkpoint for a bounded comparison window, then received the completion event to resume. Source rebuild time is separate from per-encounter clocks. These are observations, not a general latency guarantee.
remaining_limits: Cold first use still prepares the guidance/model. Changed retrieval prepares its new suffix; changed language/model reopens. Multiple overlapping native residents caused active memory churn; the three-job diagnostic was stopped after preserving its completed sample. Prefix reuse is not a host-wide memory-admission fix.
privacy: Private utterances, raw replies, process identities and checkpoint continuations remain local. Live session buffers contain the latest turn until overwritten or released; checkpoints alone exclude encounter turns.
source_receipt: Execution and inference are native. Implementation and review used rented OpenAI Codex reasoning; task-specific token totals are unavailable.
